author: reek
body: The reverse direction is written first and deliberately: an emitter checked only against its own parser agrees with itself whatever both do. Every emit row below is compared against the literal text the RFC requires, and every parse row against a value derived from the grammar rather than from what the emitter happens to produce.

author: reek
body: A round trip that starts from TEXT, not from a value: parse the literal, emit it again, and require the same characters back. Trailing zeros are the case that separates carrying the digits from carrying a quantity.
